This oversimplification disregards the nuanced understanding established through prior research. The error stems from misinterpreting or generalizing the evidence gathered, leading to an inaccurate conclusion that implies both terms (Ajuga and Cypress) represent genera in the same sense, when in fact "Cypress" is not a single genus.
